mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, increasing present value of future cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of months with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when UNRATE > 4.0%, or t-test p-value > 0.05 vs baseline.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate broad economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO decline.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 5.0% YoY signals persistent inflation requiring aggressive monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months when CPIAUCSL > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) growth signals robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of months with PAYEMS growth exceeding 100k.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1,300,000 units indicate cooling residential demand that reduces consumer confidence and triggers negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when HOUST < 1300.0.

mechanism_narrative: Declining retail sales (RSAFS) combined with rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals weak consumer demand amid monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS declines and FEDFUNDS rises.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100 (2017=100) indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profit visibility, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months when INDPRO < 100.
